description: Forecasts how long an air conditioner takes to reach its setpoint, and what the run costs. Learns from the room's own history.

glossary.setpoint: The temperature the AC is asked to reach.
glossary.forecast: The estimated time, energy and cost to reach the setpoint from the current room state.
